correctness.rationale: The stated N_w has an octagonal unit ball with exactly eight facet normals (±1,±w),(±w,±1) and dual norm max(|a|,|b|,(|a|+|b|)/(1+w)). For unit x,y set u=(x+y)/2,v=(x−y)/2. Selecting their active facets, isometry fixes the first one; exhaustive eight relative facets yield coefficient pairs (1,0),(1,δ),(k,k),(w,1),(0,1),(δ,1),(k,k),(1,w), δ=(1−w)/(1+w), k=max{(1+w)/2,1/(1+w)}. Hölder applied to αN(u)+βN(v)≥1 gives lower bound (α^{p′}+β^{p′})^{1−p}; only A=(1+δ^{p′})^{1−p}, B=(1+w^{p′})^{1−p}, and C=2^{1−p}k^{−p} can dominate. Convexity gives C≥min(A,B). δ=w exactly at w=√2−1; hence formula branches and p-independent boundary. The explicit coordinate-swapped and sign-reflected unit pairs meet equality in their respective regimes, with endpoints 0<w<1 and every p>1. For p=1 triangle inequality plus x=y gives c=1. p=2 reduces to already known quadratic Gao formula.
